integrity: Finite signed-avoidance coefficients are produced by exhaustive exact integer enumeration; infinite-time signs are established by explicit monotone inequalities. A separate exact coverage-state recurrence checks selected finite times. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only projective-plane orders 2 and 3 and independent sampling with replacement; no claim for larger orders, nonuniform laws, or a general fair-hypergraph theorem. Historical priority is not independently adjudicated.
title: A sharp stochastic-order boundary for the first two projective-plane coupon mechanisms
